info.title: MICROSERVICE-testDev-Create Catalog Cerussite Recliner Detail-v1-spec
info.description: The Cerussite Recliner Detail Management API facilitates the creation of detailed records for the Cerussite Recliner product in the catalog. This endpoint allows businesses to input and manage specifications, features, and other relevant attributes of the recliner. Typically utilized by product managers and inventory systems, the API supports efficient catalog updates and enhancements. By streamlining the details associated with the Cerussite Recliner, it enhances visibility and aids in delivering comprehensive product information to potential customers.

post.description: This endpoint allows you to create detailed information about the Cerussite recliner. It accepts the necessary information and stores it in the system for future reference.

requestBody.description: This request body allows you to provide the necessary details for creating or updating a cerussite recliner. Ensure that all required fields are properly filled out to ensure successful operation.

200.description: The request was processed successfully and the details are returned.
